title: DCM Artefact Governance: research-software and artefact archive
description:
Research-software and artefact archive accompanying the DCM Artefact Governance paper, An Artefact-Level Governance Pattern for Model Outputs Under Deep Uncertainty, which is in preparation for Environmental Modelling & Software. The manuscript is not included.

The archive contains IncrementalElectricityPack and BiomassSupplyPack schemas, governed artefacts, hourly incremental-electricity traces, future-specific multipliers, validators, fixtures, screening calculations and figure scripts. The single command python reproduce.py re-executes the documented checks and calculations and regenerates Figure 2 from the supplied inputs. The archive does not regenerate the upstream process-heat dispatch model run or the future-specific multipliers, and passing the checks does not validate the underlying models or the third-party source estimates.
